45:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aaargh!! I was trying so hard to cheer you up, $n, and now my anger has exploded all at once!」

45:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At this rate, I may be the one who draws out the $$スフィア$$'s power!」

45:t_10:51.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That voice... Are you the pilot of the blue robot that backed me up?」

45:t_10:52.en:
$n
「Yeah, that's me. ...I'm $F. Nice to meet you.」

45:t_10:53.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm $$ガロード・ラン$$. Same here.」

45:t_10:54.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sorry, but I'm a little busy. If you need something, make it quick.」

45:t_10:55.en:
$n
「I want to ask about the weapon on your $$ガンダム$$ that you call the $$サテライトキャノン$$.」

45:t_10:57.en:
$n
「You could've wiped out $$サイデリアル$$ with it. Why didn't you use it?」

45:t_10:58.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Against enemies like those, there was no need to use it.」

45:t_10:60.en:
$$ガロード$$
「That's not it. ...It's just that the $$サテライトキャノン$$... I'd rather not use it if I can help it.」

45:t_10:61.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Nothing good comes of having a weapon that's too powerful.」

45:t_10:63.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Sometimes you can't afford to stick to your ideals... But I'd still rather not use it.」

45:t_10:64.en:
$n
「...I see. Sorry for holding you up.」

45:t_10:65.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It's fine. Your backup really helped me out.」

45:t_10:67.en:
$$ガロード$$
「See you. Let's take our time talking later.」

45:t_10:69.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It sounds just like a $$スフィア$$.」

45:t_10:71.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ガロード$$'s words seem to have left quite an impression on you.」

45:t_10:72.en:
$n
「...Hey, $$ＡＧ$$... Was $$ジェニオン$$ built to steal 《$$ジェミニア#keyword$$》's $$スフィア$$?」

45:t_10:73.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I don't know for certain. But that is what I believe.」

45:t_10:74.en:
$n
「According to that $$ブルー$$ person, there are $$スフィア・リアクター$$s on this $$翠の地球$$...」

45:t_10:75.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. I hear Miss $$セツコ・オハラ$$, whom $$ギルター$$ mentioned in today's battle, is a $$リアクター$$ too.」

45:t_10:76.en:
$n
「$$ＡＧ$$... Find out as much as you can about the $$スフィア$$s.」

45:t_10:77.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. But to draw out its power...」

45:t_10:79.en:
$n
「Conflicting human emotions trigger the power of $$ジェニオン$$'s $$スフィア$$, the '$$いがみ合う双子$$'...」

45:t_10:80.en:
$n
「I'll try. I don't know how to do it yet, but...」

45:t_10:81.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe you can master the $$スフィア$$, $n, without being at the mercy of its overwhelming power.」

45:t_10:83.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's give ourselves a boost! Once again, with feeling...!」

45:t_10:84.en:
$n
「Sorry... I just can't bring myself to say that.」

45:t_10:85.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aaargh!! I was trying so hard to cheer you up, $n, and now my anger has exploded all at once!」

45:t_10:86.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「At this rate, I may be the one who draws out the $$スフィア$$'s power!」

46:t_000:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「...There really is treasure down here, right?」

46:t_000:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「If you're so skeptical, why don't you dive down and look for yourself?」

46:t_000:3.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Sorry. I took that joke a little too far.」

46:t_000:5.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「I brought you all the way here because this is real treasure. I wanted you to be the first to see it.」

46:t_000:6.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「You're just going to dump some pain-in-the-ass job on me, aren't you?」

46:t_000:7.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「...We don't know what might happen. That's why I asked you, our repairman, to come along too.」

46:t_000:8.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Are they... operating around here?」

46:t_000:9.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Yeah. Until now, they just checked $$クジライカ$$ nests, but it looks like a big force is on the move.」

46:t_000:10.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「I've sent scouts out, just in case. If things get bad, we'll get out of here right away.」

46:t_000:11.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Then what about the treasure?! You're not just gonna leave it here, are you?!」

46:t_000:12.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Pipe down. Salvaging or anything else, you've got to be alive to do it.」

46:t_000:13.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「If they show up, we have to retreat. That's the rule of this sea.」

46:t_000:14.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Tch... Nothing's gone right since that weird storm caught us up.」

46:t_000:15.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Still, we're here, alive. We should be thankful for that.」

46:t_001:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Is that a message from the scouts?」

46:t_001:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「This is bad, $$ピニオン$$! Pirates are coming!」

46:t_002:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Let's get out of here, $$ベローズ$$!」

46:t_002:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Wait, $$ピニオン$$! Something's wrong!」

46:t_003:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What are those guys doing...?」

46:t_004:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「A ship coming out of the sea?!」

46:t_004:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「A sunken ship surfaced...?! No... That ship is moving underwater!」

46:t_004:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「If we were in perfect condition, we could take her deeper, but...」

46:t_004:3.en:
$$テッサ$$
「There's nothing we can do, with her in her current state.」

46:t_004:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We should be grateful that the $$マクロス・クォーター$$'s efforts kept her from burning up.」

46:t_004:5.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「That was remarkable. You used debris to shield her from atmospheric friction while supporting the $$ダナン$$ from below.」

46:t_004:6.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Our boss's surfing skills are the best, aren't they, Lieutenant Colonel $$マデューカス$$?」

46:t_004:7.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Surfing on debris... I've seen how much there is to space combat, Captain $$ジェフリー$$.」

46:t_004:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Your generous praise honors me. But first, let us get through this situation.」

46:t_004:9.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Judging by their equipment, I don't think they're connected to $$サイデリアル$$, but...」

46:t_004:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「They're probably outlaws who claim this area as their territory.」

46:t_004:11.en:
$$ボビー$$
「I heard the fringes of 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》 were lawless. It seems the $$翠の地球$$ is too.」

46:t_004:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「A vast green ocean... And it's full of fighting here, too.」
